verdict.rationale: Summoning a terminal with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown is a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a global hotkey, dropdown or quick-access window for kitty. The remote-control, layouts, sessions and mappable-actions items cover in-app window management and scripting, not system-wide summoning.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can summon the terminal instantly with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window
